entity: Town-hall public-works tenders in Los Ríos province, Ecuador, Jan-Jun 2026 records
why: CONNECTAS and Open Contracting report one-bidder tenders across all of Ecuador (42.6% over six years; 20.5% by June 2022). Neither names Los Ríos, Quevedo or any town hall, so the pattern is known and the entity isn't.
